summary: Iteration 94 — validated the BLE hook refactor (auto-reconnect + battery) + live-ride share caption + admin feedback gate. All four review items pass on web. Backend: GET /api/admin/feedback returns 200 with HWG service token, 403 with rider token, 401 for missing/bogus token (4/4 pytest cases). Frontend: /workout still renders with bc-live toggling DEMO⇄LIVE and vr-embed-source/view/fullscreen non-overlapping; /connections opens the ble-panel via device-btn-trainer and shows the ble-unsupported notice; /summary action-share is present and tapping on web pops the fallback toast 'Sharing a ride card works on the app' without crashing. react_native_issues.issue: React Native web deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' emitted from the Animated.View toast on /summary. Reference: /app/frontend/app/summary.tsx:52 (pointerEvents is passed inside the style array which is fine, but the warning still fires from the underlying compiled markup — worth confirming the toast prop pipeline).

action_items: (Optional/minor) Silence the 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning surfaced by the summary Toast on web (move to style.pointerEvents only).
Auto-reconnect + battery pills + native share sheet remain UNTESTED on web (device-only). Please verify these on a native iOS/Android build before shipping.
critical_code_review_comments: useBleSensors.ts refactor is clean: intentional-disconnect tracking (intentionalRef) prevents auto-reconnect after user-initiated disconnect; exponential backoff (800ms * 1.6^tries, capped at 8s, max 8 tries) gives up cleanly and surfaces a rider-visible error; reconnect timers and BLE subs are torn down on unmount.
readBattery() reads Battery Service 0x180F then subscribes for updates only when isNotifiable=true, falling back silently — correct for straps that only expose a one-shot read.
onDisconnected handler correctly clears crank/wheel/control state per-device before deciding to reconnect, so the FTMS control pointer never dangles on a stale device object.

BleSensorsPanel: 'reconnecting' pill uses colors.yellow with ActivityIndicator, and BatteryPill switches color at <=20% (red) / <=50% (yellow) / else green — meets contrast and matches spec. Battery pill is gated behind `bat != null`, so it will simply not render on web (where battery stays {}).

summary.tsx rideCaption(): safe against missing stats — every field is optional and joined with double-space; falls back to '🚴 Roujaune ride' when route is unnamed. On web, shareRideCard short-circuits at Platform.OS === 'web' with a toast; on iOS uses Share.share({url,message}), Android uses Sharing.shareAsync + Clipboard fallback for the caption — good behaviour differentiation.

routes/feedback.py: GET /api/admin/feedback uses admin_router with dependencies=[Depends(auth.require_admin)] which resolves the HWG_SERVICE_TOKEN service principal correctly; response strips _id via find projection {'_id':0}.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (workout controls + LIVE/DEMO toggle + connections BLE unsupported notice + summary share fallback toast)
